# Productivity fixture provenance

Captured locally on 2026-09-19 from AutomationDirect's "Two Button Latch Example
Program", source filename `EP-MISC-005-PxK.adpro`, in Productivity Suite 4.7.2.4.
The example's original technical-support disclaimer remains in the rung comment.

`two-button-latch/project-4.7.2.4.adpro` is the unmodified native file saved by
the user in the running application. Its save metadata is SW_VER `4.7.2 (4)`,
PROJ_VER `4.7.0.1`. This is a native capture, not generated by laddercodec.

`two-button-latch/legacy-3.12.1/` contains byte-for-byte extracted entries from
the same project before that save. Metadata is SW_VER `3.12.1 (21)`, PROJ_VER
`3.12.0.1`. The original archive container was not captured before replacement.
Tests that rebuild its ZIP framing are explicitly synthetic; they must not be
treated as native archive byte-identity evidence.

`two-button-latch/rung-4.7.2.4.clipboard.bin` was copied by the user in the native
application before the new save. Both registered Java clipboard formats contained
identical 6,709-byte streams. `clipboard-manifest.json` records the observed
format IDs/names and hashes; its original `format-*.bin` names refer to the
initial capture. One copy is stored here under the descriptive rung filename.

`capture-provenance.json` records hashes of all native entry/capture artifacts.
`instruction-inventory-4.7.2.4.json` is a compact metadata report derived from the
installed JAR, not a list of instructions verified through native paste/reopen.

`generated/default-timer-4.7.2.4.xml` was produced by our headless Java harness
using the vendor's default STMR constructor and JAXB serializer. It is **not a UI
capture or a valid populated ladder instruction**; its operands are unassigned.

No generated or edited project has yet been reopened in Productivity. Native
clipboard/XML agreement tests cover cell positions, element types, wire codes,
instruction kinds, and comments, not complete execution equivalence.
